With s_j=sum_r |w_jr|², orthogonality gives sum_j s_j<=2, AM-GM gives product_r|w_jr|<=(s_j/3)^(3/2), and strict concentration inequality gives sum_j products <= (2/3)^(3/2) with equality only in one block. Thus PSD iff max|beta_j|<=3sqrt6 rho/8; explicit u=(2,1,1)/sqrt6, v=(0,1,-1)/sqrt2 witness sharpness, independently checked at symbolic endpoint. Equality rigidly forces one maximizer block and a plane perpendicular to a block body diagonal; four unoriented planes and three curvature-zero normals per plane give 12k null directions with rank one. After removing first harmonic by translation, projected support rho+Re(Z e^(3i theta))/4 gives area pi rho²-pi|Z|²/4 and sharp max/min pi rho², pi(rho²-2B²/27). Case B=0 gives all planes equal. Cubic oddness yields constant width 2rho. Proof genuinely all m>=2, n>=3m; finite diagnostics supplemental.
